subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should Google Chat add an opt-in all-Space-message ingestion mode, and if so should it use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub with user OAuth rather than the current service-account webhook model?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential type, OAuth scopes, user consent, subscription lifecycle, and which Space messages can reach the model, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design opt-in Workspace Events mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a plugin-owned design covering scopes, subscriptions, consent, allowlists, docs, and live proof before a fix PR.

options.title: Defer all-message ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as @mention/webhook-only for now and close or narrow this issue after confirming maintainers do not want the broader visibility surface.

options.title: Split thread/session work only
options.body: Treat thread replies and per-thread sessions through existing focused PRs while opening a separate product item for all-message ingestion.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in Workspace Events mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a plugin-owned design covering scopes, subscriptions, consent, allowlists, docs, and live proof before a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is mostly product/security policy across channel auth and visibility, and steipete has the strongest recent policy and access-control history in the inspected files.
